failures.evidence: The push that carried this round put `skip-checks: true` on the head of a push that carries code. `jj log -r e0ed8f32 -T description` ends with two empty lines and `skip-checks: true`, and the push it headed also carried e4b102ab7020 (packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md, CredentialRecordFacts.tsx, CredentialSessionLines.tsx, session.ts) and d4ee12282c97 (packages/dispatch/e2e/inbox.e2e.ts, packages/envoy/cmd/agent-secrets/main.go) — six files outside `.legion/INFRA-879/`, so it is a code push and `skill://legion-worker/references/skip-checks-trailer.md` gives it no trailer: 'Every other push — code, red tests, docs/solutions/, a forward merge, a rewrite — carries no such line'. GitHub therefore started no workflow run for it: `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/commits/e0ed8f326a762612900bfa14b8ba33712b78b3b7/check-runs --jq .total_count` prints `0`, the same command at d4ee12282c97 prints `0`, and the newest ci.yaml run on this branch is 41375035338 at 37217008e370 (the review handoff), created 2026-11-02T01:56:12Z and still `queued` — no run exists at either code commit of this round. The consequence is not cosmetic: sjawhar/legion's `main` ruleset 12331919 requires the status checks `ci-ok` and `pr-title`, `gh pr view 2649 --json mergeStateStatus` reads `BLOCKED`, and `statusCheckRollup` is empty, so this head can never become mergeable. The reference names exactly this outcome: 'a trailered code push gets no verdict carried, and a head with no CI is one a base that requires a check will not merge, so the merge waits and the daemon tells the issue's architect once it has waited an hour'. Read on GitHub at 2026-11-02T03:00:50Z; nothing was re-run and no run was started. No red test pins this: it is a property of a commit message and a push, not of the tree, and a test that read a workflow or a commit message to assert it would be a check of a check. The remedy is the implementer's next push — give the head a message without the trailer (the handoff commit is the head and the push carries code, so it is not a handoff-only push) and push the branch, which starts the run — after which CI at the new head is read, not re-run.

observations: One half of the premise the machine page's deletion rests on is pinned by a test and the other is not. `TestMachineLoginApprovalMintsAKeyBoundLauncherCredentialForEnrollment` (internal/broker/api/api_test.go:621) fails if the lookup answers a non-nil enrollment, so the removed Enrollment and Worker slot facts are guarded.
